evidence.description: public nonisolated(unsafe) static let shared = EcosiaAuthWindowRegistry()

candidates.explanation: The use of `nonisolated(unsafe)` on the shared singleton instance bypasses Swift's compile-time concurrency safety checks. While the class uses a private queue for internal synchronization, this attribute signals that the instance is not thread-safe, which can lead to undefined behavior if accessed in ways that violate the internal synchronization logic.
candidates.title: Use of nonisolated(unsafe) on shared instance

evidence.description: queue.async(flags: .barrier) { ... } followed by EcosiaLogger.auth.info("Cleared all windows")

candidates.explanation: The `registerWindow`, `unregisterWindow`, and `clearAllWindows` methods use `queue.async(flags: .barrier)` to modify the internal state but perform logging immediately after the call. Because the modification is asynchronous, the log message may appear before the actual insertion, removal, or clearing of the window occurs in the set.
candidates.title: Race condition between asynchronous state update and logging
